title: Manijero approved source catalog
description: Versioned admission contract for the Manijero MVP knowledge corpus. This file is the readable contract; backend/app/source_catalog.py is the executable validator and must stay in sync with it. Validation checks catalog policy and metadata only. It never fetches a document and never claims that a document is authentic, currently in force, or legally applicable.

schema_version.description: Catalog format version. Bump it, the schema, and the validator together in a reviewed change.

sources.description: Approved documents eligible for corpus ingestion. An empty array is valid and intentional: it means no document has been reviewed yet, not that the corpus is ready.

isoDate.description: Calendar date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. The validator also rejects impossible dates such as 2026-02-30.

source.description: One reviewed official document. Ordering rules not expressible here: published_on <= downloaded_on <= verified_on and reviewed_on >= downloaded_on; a valid_until earlier than the validation date makes the entry ineligible.

id.description: Unique, stable, lowercase slug such as 'rd_1048_2022'. Never derive it from a title and never reuse it.

issuing_body.description: Approved authority whose official domain hosts the document. State legislation published in the BOE is registered as 'BOE' or as 'MAPA'/'FEGA' with a boe.es URL. Adding another issuer is a reviewed schema-and-test change.

original_url.description: HTTPS link to the original published document on an approved host (exact host match, including www. aliases). Must point to a specific document, not a site root. Must not embed credentials and must not be a lookalike suffix or subdomain of an approved domain. The validator never follows redirects.

consolidated_url.description: Optional HTTPS link to the official consolidated text. Informative convenience only: it never replaces original_url, so it must differ from it and use the same issuer's approved host.

published_on.description: Date the original text was published.

downloaded_on.description: Date the reviewed copy was downloaded from original_url.

verified_on.description: Date a human last checked the downloaded copy against the original.

content_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the downloaded original. Detects silent changes; it does not prove authenticity.

review_status.description: Only explicitly human-approved documents may enter the corpus. There is no other accepted value in v1.

reviewed_by.description: Role or identifier of the human reviewer who approved this entry. Non-blank.

reviewed_on.description: Date of the human approval. Must be on or after downloaded_on.

lifecycle_status.description: Only documents currently in force may be ingested. Repealed, superseded, or expired documents must not appear as eligible.

valid_until.description: Optional end of validity for calls, deadlines, and extensions. Must be on or after the validation date; an earlier date makes the entry expired and ineligible.

campaign.description: Optional campaign label when the document is campaign-specific (for example '2026'). Leave it absent when unknown.

critical.description: Optional flag marking deadlines, amounts, and thresholds that need prominent source excerpts.

applicability.description: Optional land applicability, recorded only when known. Leave the whole object absent when unknown; never infer it, and never use 'unknown' as a value.

crop.description: Crop the document applies to, for example 'olivar'.

water_regime.description: Water regime the document applies to. Omit the key when unknown.

production_method.description: Production method the document applies to. Omit the key when unknown.
